donor_pool_sources: validation role only (same population as Experiment 8); donors are other records than the recipient; AFIB donors never overlap with SR recipients

raw_substitution_median_end_step_counts_.note: mean over leads of |donor first sample - recipient first sample|; deviation-based substitution has exactly 0 by construction

verdict: Substitution of donor DEVIATIONS (x - line through region ends) onto the recipient's own baseline line is feasible and defensible: region length identical, region end values unchanged (no step), QRS/RR/non-target samples untouched, per-lead scales comparable (see ratio). Raw-sample substitution changes the baseline and creates boundary steps and is run only as a documented variant. The donor window is positional (r-160..r-51), not a verified fibrillatory-wave segment; donor segments are called 'AFIB-donor atrial-region content'. Time reversal / shuffling are not physiologically realistic signals.
